missing_components.summary: Transport the concrete Nat constructions to every explicitly enumerable countable universe in the source theorem.
A P01-style membership-query procedure generates from an arbitrary fixed sufficiently large finite target sample.
The procedure returns an infinite sequence of pairwise-distinct elements of the target outside the fixed sample.
Transport the finite-set-only construction to every explicitly enumerable countable universe in the source claim.
The sufficiency construction has the source's algorithmic sampling and membership-oracle realization.
Existence of an approximate-breadth generator implies weak Angluin's condition.
A succinct computable generator supports sampling, support enumeration, and support-membership decisions as described by the source.
The source's membership-query and enumeration implementation requirements are realized.
Semantic exhaustive generatability of the indexed family range is equivalent to P05 weak Angluin.
Transport the stable approximate equivalence from Nat to the source's arbitrary countable string universe.
The stable approximate generator has the source's computable sampling and support-query realization.
Construct the source's countable family, prove weak Angluin, and package it with the stable-coverage impossibility.
The literal generic wording additionally requires the separation after fixing a finite countable example universe; that extra obligation is false.
